label: Draft plan — tweak anytime
note: Nothing is booked. Flights, dives and dinners are suggestions.

days.title: Travel day & arrive
items: ~5:00 AM CT leave St. Louis. Likely American via Miami (Monday departure; flights not booked)
Before: pay Entry Tax $75pp + STINAPA nature fee $40pp online
Check in at Carib Inn, pick up the truck
Groceries & water (Van den Tweel / Warehouse)
Easy evening: sunset on the waterfront

days.title: Orientation + easy reefs
items: Mandatory orientation/checkout dive + STINAPA briefing
Shore dives: Bari Reef, Buddy's Reef
Sunset at the hotel pier

days.title: North shore
items: Shore dives: 1000 Steps, Karpata
Washington Slagbaai National Park if time (nature fee covers entry)

days.title: Klein Bonaire
items: Carib Inn boat dives: No Name, Ebo's Reef
Or water taxi $25 round trip for snorkel/beach time

days.title: Salt Pier & wreck
items: Shore dives: Salt Pier, Hilma Hooker
Afternoon: Lac Bay/Sorobon or Mangrove Center kayak ~$60
Guided night dive at Town Pier

days.title: Double reefs + spa — LAST DIVE DAY
items: Shore dives: Andrea I/II, Alice in Wonderland / Angel City
Finish last dive by Sat afternoon/evening (≥24 h before flying; extra margin)
Spa: Massage Bonaire ~$90/hr or Smiling Buddha couples Thai massage

days.title: No-dive land day
items: Donkey Sanctuary
Rincon village
Flamingos (Pekelmeer / salt flats)
Souvenirs, return dive gear, pack
days.dinner: Farewell dinner: Restaurant Flora or Joe's

days.title: Fly home
items: Return truck, check out
Fly home, arrive ~10:05 PM CT
